Definition: from G4012 and G797; to flash all around, i.e. envelop in light:--shine round (about).
BiblicalUsage: Periastráptō means to flash round about, to shine around. As Paul journeyed near Damascus, a light from heaven suddenly shined round about him, and he told the story again before Agrippa: about noon a great light shone round about him and those who journeyed with him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the light that shone round about Paul was not a vision he sought but a Lord who stopped him: conversion begins when the light finds me.
